text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordanian-Palestinian summit in Aqaba on Wednesday; King Hussein and PLO leader Yasser Arafat discuss latest developments in peace process.
- Opposition parties call for countrywide conference to prepare national charter to contest parliamentary elections next November.
- Interior minister submits to Prime Minister Majali draft amendment to election law; proposals include higher quota of seats for women.
- Parliament Speaker Srour says government, deputies exchange views on amended election law.
- Majali expected to visit Qatar during first week of May.
- Jordan's powerful Moslem Brotherhood denies any splits within movement; leader says debate within movement reflects internal democracy.
- Jordanian-Palestinian summit will tackle ways of activating peace process.
- Opposition parties lobby to pressure government on expected electoral law.
